purpose: Teach: 結びつく/オーディション/去り/今季/真意/一読/一概に/トレーナー

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新規事業、当社の強みと、結びつく形で、進めろ。
lines.en: Drive the new business forward in a way that ties to our core strengths.
lines.style: Clipped, decisive opening. No hesitation. Controlled intensity — a senior voice setting the frame. Direct eye contact. Measured cadence, no room for interpretation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内コンテスト、来週、オーディション、実施します、若手の登竜門です。
lines.en: Yes. We're running an internal contest next week — an audition for our young talent pipeline.
lines.style: Clear, orderly delivery. Slight upward lift when naming the contest, then steady. Professional confidence without flourish. Ticking boxes, but genuinely engaged with the detail.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 去り行く、ベテラン社員の知恵、後輩に、引き継がせろ。
lines.en: Make sure the veterans who are leaving pass their knowledge on to the junior staff.
lines.style: Weight behind each phrase. Spare, deliberate pacing. Not urgent, but non-negotiable. The voice of someone accustomed to being heard without raising volume.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。今季の業績、好調に、推移しております、株主様、喜ばれそうです。
lines.en: Yes. This quarter's performance is holding up well — the shareholders should be pleased.
lines.style: Steady, factual tone. A hint of quiet satisfaction on 'holding up well.' Not celebrating, just reporting the truth. Professional neutrality with a warm undertone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お客様の真意、現場で、よく、聞いて、対応しろ。
lines.en: Listen carefully to what our customers really need in the field, and respond accordingly.
lines.style: Slow, intentional pacing on the first half. 'Listen carefully' lands with quiet weight. Pause before the second clause. The voice of someone who has learned this the hard way.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。重要書類、社長、一読、いただけませんか、ご確認のため。
lines.en: Yes. Could you review these important documents when you have a moment, sir? I need your sign-off.
lines.style: Respectful, slightly formal register. Soft start, careful framing of the request. Not uncertain, but genuinely deferential — the tone of someone requesting time from a senior. Light breath before 'sign-off.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 一概に、業界の景気、悪いとは言えない、当社、機会あり。
lines.en: You can't say the entire industry is struggling — there are still opportunities for us.
lines.style: Measured pushback. Opens with a slight verbal shrug on 'can't say.' Then firmer — not argumentative, but grounded. The tone of someone offering a counterpoint he believes in. Steady eye level.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内のトレーナー、外部、招聘いたしました、研修強化のため。
lines.en: Yes. We've brought in an external trainer to strengthen our internal development program.
lines.style: Confident closure. Slight emphasis on 'external' — a decision made, not a question. Settled and professional. The energy of something put in motion and owned.
